steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: I think something's wrong with the diffractometer's sensor.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Nothing's wrong with it.

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: You see, Viktor? I'm getting the same results.

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: It's not always the equipment's fault that you're not getting valid data. The data itself may exceed the scope.

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: Originium reaction metrics are above the default limit.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: They're coming, guys. We have three minutes.

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: Viktor is the youngest of us. If nothing else, we should try to get him out...

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: Who did you think was the reason that I signed up for the Londinium operation?

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: Never could just do as you're told, could you?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: How are you doing over there, Closure?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Still alive. I've got my drones, and they're loaded with—

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: I think I hear the sound of drones crashing.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: They used to be your babies.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Haha—

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: You knew it when you ordered the Self-Salvation Corps to pull out, didn't you? That was the last chance to escape.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The Originium activity data is incomplete.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I need data... from all of you.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Amiya's not here, so you're my captain, Closure.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: We all talked to Amiya before we came to Londinium.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Stop a war, and save both the Victorians and the Sarkaz? With just the few of us? That's next to impossible.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: But I chose to trust all of you. Trust in the dream of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: There isn't a single Rhodes Island operator who doesn't want to see the day when there is a cure for Oripathy, when everybody's living a better life. Doesn't that sound ridiculous to most folks?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: My only regret about dying here... is that I won't get to see that day.

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: Did you get my data, Yvres?

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: Yup. Just sent the newest batch of data over, Captain.

steps.name: Caster Operator
steps.text: Oh, and I'm not that selfless, so don't forget to put my name in when you publish your paper.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Will do.
'Communication failure detected. Signal lost imminent.'
'Importing energy fluctuation data. Initializing automatic analysis module.'
'Catastrophe scale confirmed. Developing prediction model on Originium induced environmental changes for the next 24 hours...'
'Bzzzz—Captain, shield... damaged...'
'They're... about to...'
'Hang in there... Yvres... moving towards your position— Bzzzz'
'Bzzzz—'
'Make it happen, Closure.'

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I will.
The engineer's eyes are glued to the screen in front of her.
Faster. Faster. If they fail to compile the Originium activity data, then all the squad's efforts would be for naught.
The din of war approaches.
Only a few drones remain. She can feel the enemy's cold, freezing breath.
'...Model successfully compiled.'
'Outputting safe zone locations—'

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: YES!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: All that's left is the signal tower—

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: ...Vampire. Traitor.

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: This war will go on, and you will feed it.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yikes!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: My drone—
The Sudaram's blade slices the hovering drone, sending it crashing to the ground.
That was her last combat drone.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Get out of the way!

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: Your Arts are weak and pathetic.

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: How could such a frail Vampire exist?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ouch!
Searing pain erupts and Closure feels an entire side of her body go numb.
The breath of decay invades her.
Closure can barely hold onto the signal tower. With great effort, she plants the complex equipment into the ground to lean on.
'Insufficient signal strength. Strong interference detected. Unable to broadcast safe zone location.
'Please follow the equipment manual—'

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I know! Shut up!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What kind of Vampire are you, Closure? Close those wounds! Hang in there, just a little longer...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Just get this thing up right—

a.text: ...Sleeping in the corridors again? You'll catch a cold.
Rhodes Island's basic functions are online. I think she's ready for a grand voyage.
Thank you, Chief Engineer. You've delivered your promise.
If you want to leave this ship and go back to Kazdel... Right, you told me before. You're not interested in that place.
But at least promise me you won't call yourself a talentless Vampire anymore.
You're the most talented person I've ever known, Closure. You're just different from other Vampires.
So here's my offer: as long as you still want to see the vast and unexplored parts of this land, we'll always be each other's companion.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: (I can't... I won't...)

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: (Won't let... everyone down...)

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: (...And myself.)
Closure can feel the Sudaram's cold grip close in around her neck.
War has finally claimed her.
Closure!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Who...?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: A survivor?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Signal... there's a signal...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: A Rhodes Island signal.
Grab my hand, Closure!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Dobermann?

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: It's me.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Can you stand?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Fang...

steps.name: Sudaram
steps.text: You—
A dagger pierces the Sudaram's chest, causing a massive burst of energy.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Sorry I'm late.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Misery gave us the location.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: More are coming.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Almost got it! Cover me!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Keep them away!
What is our mission? When Closure first joined Rhodes Island, then known as Babel, she asked many operators this question.
She got a different answer every time.
Some dreams are big. Others, less so.
Some gave details. Others mumbled, scratched their heads, and gave an abashed smile.
But there comes a time when they all have the same expression.
And a time when they all make the same choice.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Almost there... this is the last one.
'Core module online. Communications restored.'

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: We're coming, Closure! Hang in there!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We sent your location to the Exemplars! Help is on the way!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Finally—

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Closure? Closure! Are you okay—

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Keep your distance. Cover the artilleries and crossbowmen.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The appearance of the Nachzehrers is closely linked to Catastrophes. Do not fear their witchcraft. However bizarre it is, it's still Arts!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Remember how we marched through a Catastrophe—

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We survived a Catastrophe. We'll survive the Sarkaz!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ...Bagpipe.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Aye? I'm here.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The Duke of Gododdin spoke the truth. Tempest Platoon is under the direct authority of Parliament.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We have an obligation to answer Parliament's call.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It's a more legitimate cause for action than the duke's invitation.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Not to mention that by accepting his invitation, you, Robben, and everyone who came with us because they had no choice... will have proper identities.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Identity? Did you forget, captain? I'm retired anyways.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Besides, in that standoff with the duke earlier, ye didn't hesitate to put yer shield in front of Siege.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ...True.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Word is Siege's carryin' the Sighs of Kings... have ye seen it before, Captain?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I have.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Siege was right. It's just a piece of metal that happens to mean something to some people.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Troops approaching on our flank.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: No ID code, but I recognize them. They're the Duke of Gododdin's men.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: They've engaged the Sarkaz... and covered one of our squads just now.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If that's Gododdin's way of showing friendship, then we'll show him the same in return.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Attention Exemplars! Stand with the soldiers of Gododdin!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Not one step backward, until the last foe is vanquished!

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: The ship has reached cruising speed, sir. We're out of danger for now.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: The Sarkaz's witchcraft is most peculiar indeed. Better to fake a moment of vulnerability than to have them constantly harassing our rear.

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: The leader of the Nachzehrers has not been sighted, nor any other known powerful Sarkaz.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: I suppose they don't see Gododdin as nearly the threat that Windermere or Wellington are.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: I could call that a relief.

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: The Sighs of Kings has not left Gibsonham, sir. Should we move on to the next phase?

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: What do you think of them?

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: More of a challenge than expected. Alexandrina's forces are growing, and they are more organized and effective than we thought...

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Oh, I don't mean as an adversary.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: The Exemplars... like you said, they look the part.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: And they've worked well enough with the troops that we left behind.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Rita is with them, and looks more like the legendary White Wolf than her father did. And Windermere isn't quite as weak as the intel had her.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Maybe it's not such a joke after all, that those kids could become the Exemplars.

steps.name: Flag Officer
steps.text: Do you intend to abandon the plan for us to escort the Realmblade, then?

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: Abandon! Such a strong word.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: It is the future that Gododdin values. Alexandrina, the Sighs of Kings, the Exemplars, even Rhodes Island... perhaps we'll cross paths again on our way to the future.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Our tanks are fighting the last pocket of Sarkaz on the east side of town.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: We've successfully defended Gibsonham. It will serve as a supply point on the way to Silverrock Bluffs. However...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The terrain has changed.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The environment around Londinium is constantly changing because of Amnannam's influence. Fissures, cliffs, and rapids that should not have been there are emerging everywhere.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Silverrock Bluffs is almost constantly under severe Catastrophe. It's hard to say where our foot will land when we put it forward.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I wouldn't have believed this was our Londinium if I had anything less than absolute faith in Rhodes Island's data.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: The sun on the meadow is summery warm♪♫Filling our home with euphoria♬♪...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: After this war, we might have to change our national anthem's lyrics.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Is this time to be havin' a laugh?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You wanted to say 'we'll think about it after we take it back,' didn't you?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: But even if we really went back... would our home ever return to the way it was?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That's why we're not just going to win the war.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We're not going to let the Sarkaz destroy Londinium in the war.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We'll overcome the storm ahead.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And we won't abandon the home that the storm has ravaged.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Feist told me his squad picked up more distress signals nearby. There may be more lives saved yet.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The areas where fighting occurred with the Nachzehrers will need to be cleaned up. Rhodes Island operators will provide the usual assistance.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I want the Exemplars to work with them on these post combat affairs.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Establish supply lines, rescue and transfer the injured, and rally those who want to join us.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: The troops who returned from the front line have assembled.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Counting in the Gododdin soldiers who had their IDs wiped, the Exemplars have far exceeded the scale of a regiment.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: They want to join us?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I met with their officers. They said the Duke of Gododdin left before they could board the transports.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Preliminary screening indicates that all of them are Infected.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Sounds familiar, eh?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Duke of Gododdin left his Infected soldiers behind, just like the other dukes?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Or maybe...?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Or maybe, he intentionally picked a bunch of soldiers who had unfortunately gotten Infected, and sent them over to us.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I suspect he has ulterior motives.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: The performance of those Infected troops indicates that they're different from those we've seen before. I wouldn't call them stragglers.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: If Gododdin's intention is to keep an eye on us, then we should probably try to lose these people, or at least separate them tactically...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You know the dukes better than I, Delphine. There's a very good chance that you're right.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But right now, there's nothing we need more than unity.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If even the Exemplars chose which parts of Victoria they united...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: What would happen to the future that we dream of?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Gododdin very likely knew that we couldn't reject those men. That's why he let us leave so easily.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Then we need to be ready.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: This is not the first challenge we've had to overcome, nor will it be the last.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Sarkaz. Amnannam. Caster. The dukes.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's not just one storm that the Exemplars will have to weather.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I'll let Lieutenant Shearer know.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: To be honest, everyone's happy to get some new blood.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Plus, they're all Infected.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If it's really true that Gododdin has not abandoned them... that, in itself, is worth celebrating.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Perhaps, the unity that once seemed impossible is actually within reach.

steps.name: Pained Refugee
steps.text: It's a miracle to run into people like you.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: We're not the miracle, ma'am.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: You are, all of you, for being strong until the very end.

steps.name: Pained Refugee
steps.text: Thank you so much, regardless.

steps.name: Pained Refugee
steps.text: I can still move. Let me help you with the others.

steps.name: Pained Refugee
steps.text: This way, you can get some rest... you're not much older than my own child, now that I get a better look at you.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: We have about ten minutes of rest before we head to the next location.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: ...Closure?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: A little more time...

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: There's not much room for improvement on that Arts Unit you're holding.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Even Raidian and Mechanist could hardly do better.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Conditions will only get worse from here. The better I do, the safer you guys will be.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Rescue work around Gibsonham is complete. Next, we'll be going to... where your squad's signal was lost.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: We'll find them, alive or... otherwise.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Even if they're buried in the sand, or Originium... there will be traces.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: We'll find them and bring them home.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I know how I feel, but Fang... I want to hear your thoughts, too.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Is it regrettable for a Rhodes Island operator to die in a war between the Sarkaz and the Victorians, when they have nothing to do with either side of the war?

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Any sacrifice is regrettable.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: After Ace died, Beagle cried for many nights with his shield in her arms.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Why him? Why there? Why then?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I get that feeling too. Every single time.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But what I really want to know is... how did the people who sacrificed feel?

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Hm... I'm sure they have their own regrets.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: We're none of us saints. That's why we fear death. That's why you feel pain over your decision.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: But I have no regrets about participating in this operation.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: If not for Lava, Hibiscus, or our other Sarkaz friends, then at least for the people here, even though I don't know any of them.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: It was a Catastrophe that brought me from Columbia to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: That Catastrophe taught me one thing: that suffering does not discriminate.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: I came here today because I know that you will come when my home needs help, when the people I care about need help.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We'll be there.

a.text: You know something? I've been addicted to the web since a very young age, because that's the only place I knew without segregation.
The other Vampire children and I, Vampires and other Sarkaz, Sarkaz and everyone else, Catastrophe, nations, class, disease.
It was Theresa who took me from the confines of my home and showed me another possibility.
A ship that sails the waves of disaster, rescues those who are suffering, and fosters companionships beyond personal interest.
But the road that Rhodes Island has traveled thus far is very real.
I'll continue to analyze the anomalies caused by Amnannam. I also want to hear your answer to my question. Kal'tsit's and the Doctor's, too.
This data belongs to Yvres, to Balin, to Viktor, to Rhodes Island... one day, it may belong to everyone.
